name: NativeFactProjection

common.eventHash: DigestSchema; canonical entire fact excluding ONLY eventHash
common.actorId: IdentifierSchema; authenticated native emitter, not human reviewer
common.expiresAt: TimestampSchema; observation TTL only, >occurredAt, NOT admission validity

facts.exercise: same exact fields as assignment except kind literal exercise
facts.option-expiry: same exact fields as assignment except kind literal option-expiry; cashDelta=0/shareDelta=0

invariants: Facts are observation-only and never cash/permission authority.
Order ExecutionProjection schema is unchanged; both event kinds advance ONE native owner's stream sequence and hash predecessor.
Genesis PortfolioGenesis remains sequence1 initial checkpoint; next native/order fact is sequence2.
Proof artifact is an immutable native journal event evidence envelope, stored atomically with fact and independently hash-bound; external model claims are never accepted.
Assignment/exercise dueAt <= occurredAt; currency and source fill lineage exact. Facts may arrive after original admission expiry, no new risk implied.
One local transition may carry multiple native facts; journal transaction must atomically append ordered fact list and resulting outbox rows.
Publication retains original receivedAt on retry. No source field means unknown/reject, not fabricated default.
